## What is the gap
The vulnerability class, workflow, or output that akira-lite handles poorly or not
at all today.

## Proposed change
What you would like it to do instead. Keep in mind the skill is deliberately one
lean file, prefer sharpening an existing step over adding a new one.

## Why it belongs in akira-lite (not akira)
akira-lite is the lightweight developer review; broad offensive tooling belongs in
akira. Explain why this fits the lightweight scope.
